subject: pri-vt-td
title: PRI.VT.TD.------AF.DY.
description: Diagram in SD(SY)-19 (Spectacle-Diversion Syndrome, Level One) accompanying Braxton's claim that 'the diversion sequence in America can be talked of as patterns that occur within a given time cycle which invariably determine how a given group of people see themselves — both conceptually and vibrationally.' (C)PRI-VT-TD (primary vibrational tendencies) is crossed with AF-DY (affinity dynamics): the question is what primary-vibrational-tendencies produces when crossed with affinity-dynamics, given that the diversion sequence is described as 'extremely sophisticated manipulation' rather than 'natural progressionalism.' PROG-CONT (progressional continuance) and AFL (affinity alignment) feed downward into the right cluster around PHY-U-P (physical universe particulars) and POST (postulation). WO-EXP-PRI (world experiential principles) feeds in from the left. TRS (transference) and POL-DY (political dynamics) form the lower-left upstream. MT-INFO (multi-information) and INFO-DY (information dynamics) attach to the central crossing line. AFI (affinity insight) and (R)INTR (reality interior) hang on the right margin. Structural argument: primary-vibrational-tendencies become productive of affinity-dynamics only through a doubled mediation — world-experiential-principles on one side and progressional-continuance with affinity-alignment on the other. The diagram exposes that no single upstream sustains the crossing; the diversion sequence works precisely because it disguises itself as natural progressionalism, and the schematic insists that real affinity-dynamics requires both pre-given vibrational tendencies and live world-experiential input.
